notes.title: Issues Fixed - Small Update
notes.content:
The issues with the game attempting to connect to the wrong server has been fixed. From now on, you won't be required to have an active connection to the servers, but the game will refuse to start if you are not connected to Steam.

As a warning, I was forced to push previously unreleased content. Although it's minor changes, bugs still may occur. Please report any in the Discord server or in the community hub for the game.

I apologize for the issues with the game.

notes.title: It's FREE!
notes.content:
[h1]IT'S FREE!![/h1]

I am just as excited as you are to tell you The Backrooms Deluxe is now FREE!!!

All of the levels present until 2.0 are now free, with the only exception being Level 9 which was added in 2.1, which is only available in the new DLC.

Some features are locked behind the DLC, such as 8-player multiplayer lobbies, and challenges.

The rest, however, is free!

Have fun!

notes.title: The Backrooms Deluxe is going FREE!
notes.content:
[h2]The Backrooms Deluxe is going FREE![/h2]

You saw the title, we're making this game free upon the release of Liminality! But with that, come some changes to make sure people who already bought the game get a fair experience too.

Certain parts or features will be locked behind [b]Founder's Edition[/b], a DLC which will be available for free to all the people who bought the game already.

Here's what Founder's Edition will include:
[list]
[*] 1500 DeluxeCoins, for your spending and to make sure you will not run out of DeluxeCoins easily! (there's now a super useful new shop item coming in 2.1)
[*] The ability to make lobbies up to 8 players, now regular free lobbies are limited to only 2 players (might change).
[*] Challenges Mode, which has been locked behind the DLC
[*] Level 9, which is an optional level that's not available in multiplayer.
[*] The ability to support me!
[/list]

To people who already have the game in their library, not much will change, they will redeem the 1500 DeluxeCoins when they like, and move on with their day.
These changes are required to give a fair experience to gamers who bought the game already and to give a chance for people who want to play this game, to experience it, and support me in the process if they'd like.

notes.title: The Backrooms Deluxe v0.15
notes.content:
[h2]Update 0.15[/h2]
Finally, after almost 2 months since the latest update and 4 months since the last very major update here is one of the biggest updates yet.
Bug fixes, lots of changes, fixed the damn broken UI and 6 new levels were added.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Toned down the VHS filter's chromatic distance (0.0008 -> 0.0002)
    [*] Turned off the signal distortion (previously 0.04)
    [*] Turned off the timestamp
    [*] Added 6 new levels!
[list]
        [*] Level 5: Terror Hotel
        [*] Level 6: Lights Out
        [*] Level 7: Thalassophobia
        [*] Level 19: The Attic
        [*] Level 34: Sewage Swimming
        [*] Level -69: Roads to Abyss
[/list]
[*] Bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes and bug fixes.
[*] Fixed movement
[*] [b]REMOVED FALL DAMAGE LETS GOOOOOOO[/b]
[*] Brought back the OG Level Fun spawn from 0.7
[*] Added a banning system to ban toxic players
Note: you can only get banned if you did something in the Discord server or interacted in a bad way with the community. Your in-game actions will NOT get you banned unless you modified your game unlocking any of the content that is not currently accessible in the game. In most cases, you will receive a temporary warning but in more extreme cases you might get banned permanently without notice. Most of these bans are temporary and will be removed upon expiration/appeal.
[*] Added an in-game announcement system. You will now see 4 different types of in-game announcements:
[list]
[*] InfoPositive: does NOT affect the game at all and is just a small announcement
[*] Info: very similar to InfoPositive, doesn't affect the game
[*] Warning: gives information about an in-game problem that does NOT affect the ability of playing a full game but might give some complications
[*] Error: give information about an in-game problem that affects your ability of playing a full game (aka broken achievements, bugs that do not allow for progression in the levels, etc.)
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: EXTREMENESS Challenge!
notes.content:
[h1]The EXTREMENESS Challenge[/h1]

Welcome to the very first The Backrooms Deluxe EVENT CHALLENGE!

[b]You have until September 30th to submit your speedrun.[/b]
[i]Time may be extended in case we do not get at least 5 submissions[/i]

Speedrun the game on Extremeness% on the speedrun.com page which you can find [url=https://www.speedrun.com/The_Backrooms_Deluxe]here[/url].

[h2]Rules 📜[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can [b]not[/b] switch save slot.
[*] You can [b]not[/b] change the difficulty after starting the run.
[*] You have to play in [i][u][b]extreme[/b][/u][/i] mode.
[*] You cannot die. If you die, delete your save slot, stop recording and start a new run. Doesn't matter if you're on Level 3999 and you use the chairs bug. Your fault dude.
[*] Have fun. This is mandatory, if you do not have fun your run will be rejected.
[/list]

[h2]Prizes 🏆[/h2]

First place:
[list]
[*] Special Extremeness Winner Role in the [url=https://bit.ly/lorygames]Discord Server[/url]
[*] 2x The Backrooms Deluxe Game Keys
[/list]

Second place:
[list]
[*] Special Extremeness Role in the [url=https://bit.ly/lorygames]Discord Server[/url]
[*] 1x The Backrooms Deluxe Game Key
[/list]

Third place:
[list]
[*] Special "Partecipation Trophy" Role in the [url=https://bit.ly/lorygames]Discord Server[/url]

[/list]

Remember to join the [url=https://bit.ly/lorygames]Discord Server[/url] for updates about this event!

[h3]Good Luck![/h3]

notes.title: The Backrooms Deluxe v0.8.1
notes.content:
[h2]New Update![/h2]
[h3]What's new?[/h3]

[i]I advice you to reset your save file due to achievement changes and overall enjoyability[/i]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Optimized the game (now runs 30FPS on potato PCs and 60FPS on high-end PCs)
[*] Better settings menu
[*] Load Game system
[*] Multiplayer!
[*]   = Multiplayer is very buggy and experimental at the moment.
[*]   = Multiplayer has been disabled for the time being. I am still working on bringing it back
[*] Better Level 2 Post-Processing
[*] Better overall UI and settings
[*] Added Level 0.1
[*] Added a secret achievement
[*] You should consider going into the elevator in Level 0...
[/list]

[i]Hope yall enjoy the new update![/i]
